input: Get a referral letter from my GP for a specialist

gold.taskTitle: Get a GP referral letter for a specialist
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a referral letter from their general practitioner in order to see a medical specialist.

questions.title: Which type of specialist do you need a referral to?
questions.description: Identify the specific medical specialty, e.g. cardiologist, dermatologist, orthopaedic surgeon.

questions.title: What condition or symptom is driving this referral?
questions.description: Understand the medical reason or concern the user wants addressed by the specialist.

questions.title: Do you already have a GP, or do you need one?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user is registered with a GP practice or still needs to find and register with one.

questions.title: Have you already spoken to your GP about this issue?
questions.description: Determine whether an initial consultation has taken place or if that is still a required step.

questions.title: Is there a specific specialist or clinic you want to be referred to?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred specialist, hospital, or clinic in mind for the referral.

questions.title: How urgently do you need this referral letter?
questions.description: Establish the timeframe or deadline the user is working within to obtain the referral.

questions.title: Are you using public healthcare, private insurance, or self-funding?
questions.description: Clarify the funding or insurance pathway, as this affects how the referral process and letter should be handled.
